Jordan / team —

Attached is a proposed DPA language set and a short memo that explains why we recommend EU Commission 2021 SCCs + a compact transfer-impact addendum for third-country subprocessors (see SCCs_comparison_20260712.xlsx). Summary of the proposals: 

1) Roles: Redwood remains a processor. Sapphire is the controller for customer data. We propose a sentence in Section 2: "Customer (Controller) directs processing as set forth in the Order Form; Redwood (Processor) processes Customer Data on Controller's documented instructions." This keeps liability lines clean and matches our standard ordering.

2) Subprocessors: We propose a two-tier approval process —
- Redwood-managed subprocessors (listed in our manifest) — notice provided and objections within 10 business days.
- Customer-managed key or Private deployments: for any subprocessor that would require access to CMK or plaintext keys, require express prior written consent.

3) SCCs + Transfer Impact Addendum: Recommend using 2021 SCCs as the baseline. Add a short Transfer Impact Addendum to document any compensating safeguards for APAC transfers (e.g., contractual controls, encryption at rest, localized logging). If Sapphire insists on bespoke SCCs we should route to Legal but expect a longer negotiation.

4) Retention & Deletion: Proposed language: "Processor will delete or return Customer Data within 90 days of termination unless retention is required by applicable law; cached inference artifacts will be deleted within 30 days by default, unless otherwise specified in the Order Form." This addresses the privacy team's ask while giving flexibility on cached inference data.

5) Evidence: Ben should provide a one-pager with SOC 2 coverage, encryption at rest, and a copy of our subprocessor attestations for the items in the manifest. I flagged the KMS ask as an Order Form option — we can offer CMK on Dedicated & Private only, and a paid add-on for Hosted instances.

Open items for our counsel: whether the "delete within 90 days" clause needs specific exception language for legal holds; if so we propose a carveout referencing lawful order/process.

- Jordan: send consolidated DPA + Order Form option set to Miller & Jones and Sapphire Legal.
- Ben: subprocessor_manifest_sapphire_20260714.csv + SOC 2 one-pager by EOD 7/14.
- Karthik: pricing note for CMK options by midday 7/14.
